text: For the beef it should definitely not be ground beef I think that we should specify flanken or chulent meat. Also I don't remember if this is already a recipe but we should add optional something like a lamb shank also add optional like some beef bones or lamb or veal bones
note: Yidi answered the c4 questions (Nov 19, 2026): olcha goes in just before the water in the crock pot. The apple is shredded/grated and is added in the pan after the carrots and the other pan vegetables. The orange squash goes in with the apple. The optional beef/lamb/veal bones go in with the meat/shank in step 3. Apply the requested edit and add these ingredients to the steps accordingly.
